note: Both arms read the repositories at one path -- the MCP arm's git server reads the image's own /data/repos in the run's container, and each mirage /data/repos mount is a copy of one taken out of the same image; no tool this task enables reads the rest of /data. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. Slack is the fake both arms read, seeded per run from Atlas's export.
